name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional, beginning with a passion for organizational psychology and a chance encounter with a racing team seeking to improve their staff retention. After completing his master's degree in Human Resource Management, he initially worked for a tech startup, but the allure of the track proved too strong. He joined Prema Junior two years ago, bringing a fresh perspective to team dynamics and talent acquisition.

Bjørn focuses on fostering a supportive and high-performance environment within the team. He believes that a happy and motivated crew translates directly into success on the track. He is particularly adept at identifying and nurturing young talent, and creating tailored development plans for each team member. His data-driven approach, combined with genuine empathy, sets him apart in the paddock.

Bjørn champions inclusivity and diversity within the team, always looking for ways to improve the overall atmosphere. Outside of the HR realm, he is keen on developing his technical knowledge of motorsport to better understand the needs of each team member.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Bjørn is of average height with a slender build and a friendly face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Has a habit of color-coding his files based on the urgency of the task.
Starts every team meeting with a motivational quote.
